{{Otheruses|Consular}}
[[File:TantiveIVFinal.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], consular ship of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].]]
{{Quote|This is a consular ship&hellip; we're on a diplomatic mission&hellip;''"<br />"''If this is a consular ship, where is the Ambassador?|[[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The term "'''consular ship'''" referred to any vessel officially used by a member of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].
